description.value:
A live tattoo worked in consecrated Choir ash; it moves a little when no one is looking. Once per day, reroll a failed save against a spirit, the dead, or a fear effect and keep the new result.

Rider: The Choir of Ash always knows where you are, treats you as a member who has lapsed, and will one day ask you to make that right.

cinderfall.incomplete: 'Reroll a failed save and keep the new result' has no rule-element key anywhere in pf2e -- confirmed absence across the whole engine, same finding as every reroll-shaped mutation flagged in the prior pass. The Choir-of-Ash tracking/debt rider is narrative, not a mechanical claim.
